description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suwarapola, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
